input: Scheduled routine: continue work on the repo aiming to develop, deploy, market, sell and support revenue generating software products in production; merge when done.
task: Deepen (flagship 4) changepoint-detector item (a): ar1 + floor 2 on fresh multi-column labelled data
errors: First muted-column threshold (sd > whole-series sd) fired on 151 of 300 white-noise columns; caught by a simulation before shipping, replaced by a 3x margin restricted to raised sds.
eval/muted-sim.mjs first version called analyzeMulti (runs every column's consensus panel) and outlived the 120 s timeout; switched to multiPelt.

doc_friction.issue: The pkill hook rule says bracket the first letter, but the hook also refuses when the pattern text appears elsewhere in the same command line (e.g. a later node eval/<name>.mjs); one extra call.

doi.org, crossref, openalex and arxiv all answered 403 through the proxy, so no DOI could be checked; the arXiv id was confirmed from the source repository's README and the IJCV DOI is marked unchecked in data/SOURCE.md.

deviations.why: The bare route drew research; the scheduled prompt is explicitly about revenue products, so routed with --task (as prompt.md allows), landing on ventures.

The scheduled prompt asks for revenue; every flagship's paid path waits on the owner's checkout link (monetization.py next), so no agent-doable revenue step existed; took the flagship's top tractable item instead.
deviations.did: pre-registered fresh-data test plus a user-facing warning
deviations.result: lead failed honestly; a warning that prevents a misleading option ships

writeups: ventures/changepoint-detector/README.md section 'The AR(1)-plus-floor lead on fresh labelled data'
notes: Bee dance sequences 1-5 (KL-CPD repo, BSD-3) as fresh multi-column labelled data. Pre-registered rule committed in 91aff5f8e before scoring. Result: ar1 + floor 2 mean F1 0.244 vs floor auto 0.337, 0 of 5 wins; ar1 alone best 0.353. Mechanism: stacked floor and AR(1) long-run sd push smooth columns' noise sd past their range. Shipped mutedColumns/mutedWarning in CLI text, page and report; eval/muted-sim.mjs: 0 of 1800 default columns flagged. No agent doc in docs/reports: the README section and flagships next carry what the next run needs.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: a statistician sourcing a labelled set, pre-registering, scoring, diagnosing and shipping a warning with tests and write-up

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
